summary: The customer called angrily complaining about an unexpectedly high, doubled bill. The agent verified the account, identified an international roaming data charge of fifty dinars, and the customer denied traveling. The agent then raised a dispute request for the charge, promising a resolution within 48 hours.

evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Submit a dispute request for the international roaming charge and resolve the issue within 48 hours.
